kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

lines.say: Too many thoughts tonight? This is for you.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul. Psalm ninety four, verse nineteen.
lines.big: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

lines.say: When the thoughts pile up, let his comfort be the last one.
lines.big: When the thoughts pile up, let his comfort be the last one.

lines.say: Lord, let your comforts delight my soul tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.
